ms.promise:
Legal Onboarding: 
Know your business (KYB) process completed with Mercuryo, which verifies the Tokeo Entity, and the identity beneficial owners of the Tokeo. This involves:
・Providing evidence of business incorporation to Mercuryo (Business registration details, certificate of incorporation)
・Providing evidence of beneficial ownership (Owner identities, passport verification and liveliness check)

Access: 
Provisioning Tokeo access to the Mercuryo Sandbox environment (which allows for development to commence on Credit Card instantiation via Google and Apple pay solutions.

Target Audience: The target audience for this milestone is specifically the Tokeo developers, and will enable secure provisioning of the Mercuryo API and credit card issuance services. 

This will allow development on Tokeo server-side, and mobile applications to support the broader outcomes of this proposal.
ms.criteria:
Access
・The know Your Business (KYB) process is completed.

Onboarding
・Sandbox access to Tokeo developers is verified by logging into Mercuryo API portal with the provided credentials

ms.criteria:
Successful execution of all tests which will cover unit, test and integration level scenarios:
・Ability to create a virtual credit card via Tokeo / Mercuryo
・Ability to fund / deposit a card with ADA
・Ability to view card in Apple or Google Wallet
・Ability to use credit card (spend) where mastercard accepted.
・Internal Security Quality Review highlights no vulnerabilities
・Exception scenarios adequately handled (ie error messages, and support channel funnelling)
